about_the_game:
Step into Ooble Gardens, a cozy world where you play as an Ooble gardener, tending to a giant garden pot in a quiet backyard. Care for the playful Oobles by crafting their dream fairy garden. Using the offerings they give you, merge and combine to discover an endless variety of cozy furniture to decorate the garden with!

The Garden

Set in a giant garden pot in a backyard, decorate this empty pot to transform it into a warm and whimsical fairy garden for little Oobles to live and play in!

Oobles!

Meet Oobles, whimsical and playful spirits of nature that reside in the garden pot, dreaming visions of their ideal fairy garden that you can help create! Accept their offerings that can range from flowers to even mushrooms to decorate and build the garden with.

Combine, Discover, Repeat!

Using the offerings that Oobles give you, merge and combine them to discover countless cozy furniture options to decorate and create a whimsical fairy garden! As you discover new combinations, it'll add to your journal. Experiment with different combinations to discover and complete your journal!​
